subject: Billing ingestion & vendor setup — portal vs email and template questions
messages:

Subject: Billing ingestion & vendor setup question

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — we're excited to get set up in Redwood's system. Two quick things so we can invoice cleanly: do you prefer invoices uploaded to a supplier portal or emailed to AP? If email is fine, do you have a required subject line or attachment format?

Also, can you confirm what fields you need on the invoice (PO placement, line-item detail level, service dates)? We want to match whatever your AP automation expects so payments don't get delayed.

Finally, where should we send our onboarding forms and W-9? Do you need bank details now for EFT, or at invoice time?

Appreciate the guidance — trying to avoid back-and-forth after the first invoice.

Best,
Nathan Cole
Billing Ops — Braxton Analytics
billing@braxton.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Billing ingestion & vendor setup question

Hi Nathan — great to meet you. Short answers first: we prefer the supplier portal for ingestion (fewer manual steps), but we accept invoices by email to ap@redwood.com if portal upload isn't possible.

Portal: https://redwood.app/supplier-portal/upload?acct=braxton (please upload the completed onboarding form + W-9).
Email: ap@redwood.com (subject: Redwood PO #[PO#] | Braxton Analytics | Invoice [Invoice #])

Required invoice fields (minimal):
- Redwood PO number (if issued)
- Invoice number
- Invoice date
- Service start/end or invoice period
- Line items with quantity/unit price and totals
- Tax (if applicable)
- Total due and currency
- Remit address / bank details (for our records)
- Payment terms (we default Net 30 unless amended by contract)

Attachments we need for onboarding: W-9 (or local tax equivalent), completed Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf, and bank authorization/letter for EFT. I've attached the Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf to this message for convenience.

PO timing: once procurement receives the completed forms and W-9, we typically issue a PO within 48 business hours. If anything looks missing, we'll flag it back via the portal or email.

If you plan to email invoices, please include the PO number in the subject line so AP's parser can auto-match. Portal uploads will match automatically to the PO when the PO# is present in the invoice fields.

I'll loop in Karthik to confirm tax/banking questions.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Sr. Manager, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-15T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing ingestion & vendor setup question

Hi Nathan — thanks for reaching out. A few procurement notes to avoid later exceptions:

1) Tax specifics: please confirm whether Braxton is US-based for 1099 purposes or if you have VAT registration (EU). If non-US, provide the equivalent tax form.
2) Banking: we prefer ACH/EFT. Please provide bank name, account type, account number (or bank letter). We will run micro-validation in onboarding.
3) Invoice template items: please include a separate line for "Service period" and a field for "Contract/Statement of Work ID". Those are required for automated GL coding on our side.
4) PO issuance: once onboarding is complete we will create PO-2026-8472 and share a PDF. Please reference that PO number on all subsequent invoices.

If you can upload the completed Supplier_Onboarding_Form.pdf and your W-9 to the portal now, that will speed things up. We generally move faster when everything is in the portal vs. email attachments.

Thanks — looping Marcus who owns AP for payment flow questions.

-Karthik
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference

Hi Nathan — confirmed: we received the uploads and W-9 in the portal. I've asked procurement to generate the PO; attached is PO-2026-8472.pdf for your records.

A few final notes to avoid hold-ups on the first invoice:
- Please put PO-2026-8472 in the invoice subject line and in the invoice body (top-right typically).
- Include Contract ID: CON-6749 in the "Contract/Statement of Work ID" field.
- Service period should be explicit (e.g., "2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31").
- We pay Net 30 from invoice receipt date (unless your contract specifies otherwise).

If portal upload fails for any reason, send invoices to ap@redwood.com with the subject formatted as: "PO-2026-8472 | Braxton Analytics | Invoice [#]". That will trigger the parser and minimize delays.

Marcus — please watch for the first invoice next week and confirm ETA once payment is scheduled.

Thanks and welcome aboard.

Attachments: PO-2026-8472.pdf

Soojin
